findings.message: `CAST(event_date AS STRING) LIKE '2026%'` wraps the partition column `event_date` in CAST(... AS STRING), so BigQuery can't use it to skip partitions of `proj.analytics.events`; the query reads every partition (2.1 TB in all).
findings.fix: Compare `event_date` itself with a constant, for example `event_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
